project.location: Plot Bearing No / CTS no / Survey Number/Final Plot no. 2841 pt at Borivali - 400097

amount.interest_rate_description: 9% pa. along with further applicable interest till full refund of the amount to the complainant

reliefs.reasoning: The parties settled their dispute amicably as per consent terms, which included a refund of the amount. The primary order disposed of the complaint as settled, granting the refund as per the terms.

supplementary_proceedings.reasoning: The respondent failed to comply with the previous order (based on consent terms) to refund the complainant's amount, despite being duly served notice for the non-compliance hearing. Therefore, a recovery warrant under Section 40(1) of RERA is issued against the booked flat in the said project.

extraction_notes: The primary order (Page 11) disposed of the complaint as settled based on consent terms, without detailing the specific amount or deadlines. The details regarding the refund amount (Rs. 6,56,471 including interest at 9% p.a. till June 2022) and specific complainant/respondent information were primarily extracted from the 'Details of the attachable assets' section (Page 2) and the 'NON-COMPLIANCE APPLICATION' order (Page 8-9), which refer back to the original settlement.
